page.overview:
What is Caedere Squad?

The Caedere or "Butchers" were specialised shock assault units within the ranks of the World Eaters Legion during the Great Crusade and Horus Heresy eras in the late 30th and early 31st Millennia.

They were formed from the most savage and bloodthirsty warriors in the XIIth Legion, all of whom had undergone prohibited psycho-surgery and now possessed the forbidden cortical implants known as the Butcher's Nails.

But the Caedere had a distinct difference that set them apart from their berzerk brethren, for they were nearly uncontrollable away from the field of battle.

Following the reunification with their lost Primarch Angron upon the world of Nuceria, the bloody-handed primarch enacted many changes within the structure of the XIIth Legion.
